objective: Produce a source-anchored operational brief of the admitted inference-fabric modules
prompt: Return only strict JSON using schema giga.operational-brief.v1. Top-level fields must be schema, project, source_packet_sha256, entrypoints, state_stores, failure_paths and operating_rules. Document every admitted entrypoint, durable state store, required failure path and enforced operating rule exactly once. Every claim needs one or more exact path:line anchors from the bound packet. Responsibilities, triggers, containment and rule statements must be concrete rather than generic. Failure-path confidence must be certain for directly encoded behaviour. Do not use Markdown or cite files outside the packet.
